translations.web: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.
translations.bsb: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.
translations.kjv: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
